answer: Every mining tick the node publishes a beacon and requires each attestation to be a linkable ring signature over a candidate set drawn from the agent's meadow of recent co-attesters. A reused key image proves two attestations share one signer, and both rows burn their slice. Clones then need not only fresh keys but non-overlapping cohorts: timber cut from one forest links instantly, so the oasis of attestation rewards stays open only to identities presenting unlinked rings across epochs.
